rules: Retain the 20 previously inspected text cases excluding periodicals, teaching presentation and blank notes page, plus all 10 inspected table cases. Fill text to 30 with the first 10 SHA256(path)-ordered uninspected business-keyword filenames. Fill tables to 20 with first 3 easy business-keyword cases and first 7 hard SERFF/FBLB/BRWS insurance candidates in SHA256(path) order. Visually inspect new candidates before final freeze. Filename candidates are not domain judgments.
limits: Purposive business-relevant demonstration, no population weights or business coverage percentage.
Ten easy and ten hard tables deliberately oversample hard cases; additional hard cases concentrate on insurance.
Page excerpts do not measure whole-document completion or operational invoice extraction.
Local text-layer parsers have no OCR; scanned inputs remain eligible.
